steps.message: Create a new drawing in Simple Draw Pro. Name it elit_2023_01_18_tough_house.jpg. Save it in the Pictures folder within the sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area.

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "echo 'APP-EXTERNAL'; ls -R /sdcard/Android/data/com.simplemobiletools.draw.pro 2>/dev/null; echo '---DRAW-DIRS---'; find /sdcard -maxdepth 3 -type d \( -iname '*draw*' -o -iname '*simple*' \) 2>/dev/null; echo '---PICTURES-JPG---'; find /sdcard/Pictures -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*.jpg' -o -iname '*.jpeg' -o -iname '*.png' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 50"
